current_controller_baseline: unmeasured; typed_control_fixture is expected policy behavior derived from annotations, not actual controller execution or comparable model predictions
limitations: 40 previously observed synthetic Russian text events; replay regression, not fresh held-out generalization
no calibrated reliability or monetary cloud-saving claim
one-class GLiNER output has unknown margin and always escalates

metric_definitions.accuracy: correct / observed; undefined when observed=0 (serialized as 0)
metric_definitions.availability: observed / count; errors always escalate and are excluded from class confusion
metric_definitions.non_escalated: counterfactual signals only; shadow mode actually preserves all controller work
metric_definitions.profile_first_attempt_wall_ms: first attempt wall time, not proof of a cold model load
metric_definitions.screening_gates: quality, availability, critical errors and more correct non-escalated signals than the existing extractor; passing still requires a full controller quality/cost benchmark before selection
metric_definitions.warm_wall: successful attempts except the first attempt of each profile; never reset at the dev/test boundary

network: one persistent internal-only service per experiment

worker_cpu_sampling.method: docker stats sampled approximately every 3 seconds over the complete experiment; not exact CPU-time accounting
